guard: Pending bootstrap cleanup uses the original native lifecycle retirement before verified endpoint containment and registration abort
why: The internal source helper runs against an owned native broker with existing grant builders, separately scoped fixture scanners, a real issuer-produced bootstrap connection, a controlled endpoint ledger/holder and a foreign-owner positive control. Native gate/head/ledger state, KICK and registration CAS are observed. This is helper and broker execution, not external admission, a production plane claim, prepared-manager issuance or hosted execution. Source imports build no mutant package dist.

mutations.name: registration abort precedes native lifecycle retirement
mutations.expectRed: native lifecycle retirement precedes endpoint abort
mutations.cell: native lifecycle retirement precedes endpoint abort

mutations.name: changed host admission coordinates authorize retirement
mutations.expectRed: changed environmentId refuses before native movement
mutations.cell: changed environmentId refuses before native movement

mutations.name: ordinary manager gates enter environment cleanup
mutations.expectRed: ordinary registration is not cleanup authority
mutations.cell: ordinary registration is not cleanup authority

mutations.cell: completed registration is not cleanup authority

mutations.name: missing retirement mechanics is detected only after the native freeze
mutations.expectRed: missing native policy refuses before any fence
mutations.cell: missing native policy refuses before any fence

mutations.find: for (const row of rows) await barrier.revoke(row);

mutations.cell: unverified endpoint eviction prevents abort and completed result

mutations.cell: lost endpoint abort CAS cannot return completed cleanup
